title: Cardiovascular disease risk context
text: Important modifiable cardiovascular risk factors include tobacco use, unhealthy diet, physical inactivity and harmful alcohol use. Raised blood pressure, blood glucose, blood lipids, overweight and obesity are measurable intermediate risk factors.

title: Type 2 diabetes risk context
text: Risk is higher with overweight or obesity, age 45 or older, a parent or sibling with type 2 diabetes, low physical activity, previous gestational diabetes and some related metabolic conditions. Individual assessment must account for the person's complete history.

title: COPD symptoms and risk context
text: COPD commonly causes persistent cough, breathing difficulty, wheeze and tiredness. Tobacco smoking and air pollution are major causes; occupational dusts and fumes can also contribute. Rapid worsening of breathing symptoms needs timely clinical assessment.
source: WHO Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease fact sheet — https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/chronic-obstructive-pulmonary-disease-%28copd%29

title: Depression assessment context
text: Assessment and management of depression in adults should consider symptom severity, duration, functional impairment, previous history, coexisting conditions, personal preferences and safety concerns, using shared decisions about care.
source: NICE NG222 Depression in adults — https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng222
